pathology_diagnosis.symptoms: Dark brown circular necrotic lesions with concentric target rings on lower foliage.
pathology_diagnosis.chemical_control: Apply Chlorothalonil or Azoxystrobin foliar spray at 7-10 day intervals.
pathology_diagnosis.organic_control: Spray copper octanoate (copper soap) or potassium bicarbonate.
pathology_diagnosis.cultural_practices: Prune lower leaves 12 inches above soil; maintain strict drip irrigation.

recommendation.chemical_spray: Apply Chlorothalonil fungicide every 7-10 days during high humidity.
recommendation.cultural_action: Prune foliage 12 inches above soil line; prevent overhead irrigation wetting.
